verdict.rationale: Parsec is a remote-desktop SaaS product, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The Teams API for deployment automation and audit logs is only a developer building block, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI docs all returned 404, so nothing supports agent connectivity via MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
